instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure /smartshunt-phase2 is an isolated route area with its own sub-navigation bar.
Do NOT alter the canonical main pages or canonical top navigation.
Visually tag every metric with either 'DC (SmartShunt)' or 'AC (Trucki/SUN)' to avoid confusion.
Ensure responsiveness on 390x844 viewports with overflow-x: hidden on all containers.
Add data-testid to all buttons, tabs, inputs, metrics, and cards for robust E2E testing.
